entries.name: Westwood Studios
entries.summary: EA closed Westwood Studios in Las Vegas while consolidating its studios into EA Los Angeles.

sources.title: EA consolidates studios, closes Westwood
Il caso Westwood: cosa è successo veramente

entries.check: GameSpot, 30 Jan 2003: "significant layoffs at Westwood's Las Vegas studio" and "the studio's final closure on March 31"; Multiplayer.it, 30 Jan 2003: "la chiusura totale di Westwood Studios (Las Vegas)".
entries.note: GameSpot reported on 30 January 2003 that the studio would close on 31 March 2003; no source found confirms the final day, so only the year is given.

entries.name: Pandemic Studios
entries.summary: EA shut down Pandemic Studios in Los Angeles, laying off around 200 people and moving the rest to EA Los Angeles.

sources.title: EA Shutters Pandemic Studios

entries.check: SoCalTech, 18 Nov 2009: "Electronics Arts is shutting down Los Angeles-based Pandemic Studios"; around 200 laid off.

entries.name: Playfish
entries.summary: EA wound down Playfish, the London maker of The Sims Social and Pet Society, after layoffs and the end of its Facebook games.

sources.title: Redundancies hit EA Playfish
The One Thing EA Has Always Been Good At Is Killing Video Game Studios

entries.check: MCV/DEVELOP, 16 Apr 2013: layoffs at Playfish and EA ending The Sims Social, SimCity Social and Pet Society; Kotaku, 21 Oct 2026: "Playfish – Purchased in 2009. Closed in 2013."
entries.note: EA did not announce a closure. In April 2013 Playfish's co-founder said it had been split across other EA studios in 2012 and had not closed completely.

entries.name: Danger Close Games
entries.summary: EA disbanded Danger Close, the Medal of Honor studio; its staff left or moved to DICE and other EA teams.

sources.title: EA confirms Danger Close team disbanded

entries.check: MCV, 14 Jun 2013, quoting Patrick Söderlund: "Danger Close as it was doesn't exist anymore."
entries.note: Many staff moved to DICE LA, but EA described the studio as disbanded, not merged.

entries.name: Mythic Entertainment
entries.summary: EA closed Mythic Entertainment, the Warhammer Online studio, in Fairfax, Virginia.

sources.title: EA Shutters Warhammer Online Developer Mythic

entries.check: Game Informer, 29 May 2014, quoting EA: "We are closing the EA Mythic location in Fairfax, Virginia."

entries.name: Maxis Emeryville
entries.summary: EA closed Maxis's Emeryville studio and moved Maxis development to its other studios.

sources.title: EA is shutting down Maxis Emeryville, the studio that brought you SimCity and The Sims

entries.check: The Next Web, 4 Mar 2015: "EA today suddenly closed Maxis' Emeryville office."

entries.name: Visceral Games
entries.summary: EA closed Visceral Games, the Dead Space studio, and moved its Star Wars game to another EA team.

sources.title: An update on the Visceral Star Wars project
EA closes Dead Space studio Visceral Games

entries.check: EA (Patrick Söderlund): "Our Visceral studio will be ramping down and closing"; the A.V. Club dates it 17 Oct 2017.

entries.name: Codemasters Cheshire
entries.summary: EA merged Codemasters Cheshire, its DiRT team, into Criterion Games to work on Need for Speed.

sources.title: Dirt team Codemasters Cheshire merged with Need for Speed studio Criterion

entries.check: VGC, 12 May 2022: the Cheshire team "has been integrated into" Criterion Games; "No redundancies have been made as a result of the move."

entries.name: Titanfall Legends
entries.summary: EA and Respawn reportedly cancelled Titanfall Legends, a single-player game set in the Apex Legends and Titanfall universe.

sources.title: Report: EA Cancels Unannounced Single-Player Titanfall Game Titled "Titanfall Legends"

entries.check: MP1st, 1 Feb 2023, citing Jason Schreier (Bloomberg) and three people familiar with the matter; EA did not announce it.
entries.note: Dated by the report; the cancellation itself was not announced.

entries.name: Star Wars FPS (Respawn)
entries.summary: EA stopped early development of Respawn's Star Wars first-person action game.

sources.title: A note from Laura Miele

entries.check: EA, 28 Feb 2024: "we have decided to pivot away from early development on a Star Wars FPS Action game".

entries.name: Ridgeline Games
entries.summary: EA wound down Ridgeline Games as a standalone Battlefield studio in Seattle; some of its team moved to Ripple Effect.

sources.title: A note from Laura Miele

entries.check: EA, 28 Feb 2024: "we'll be winding down Ridgeline as a standalone studio in Seattle", with some team members moving to Ripple Effect.
entries.note: Only some of the team moved, so this is a closure, not a merger.

entries.name: Origin
entries.summary: EA shut down its Origin PC client and store, which the EA app replaced.

sources.title: EA will shut down Origin later this year
Update your operating system for the EA app

entries.check: Game Developer, 21 Jan 2025: "EA will shut down its Origin storefront on April 17, 2025"; EA Help, archived 1 May 2025: "Origin has shut down."
entries.note: The day is the date EA set in advance; EA's help page confirmed the shutdown had happened by 1 May 2025.

entries.name: Black Panther
entries.summary: EA cancelled Black Panther, the game Cliffhanger Games was developing.

sources.title: EA has cancelled its Black Panther game and closed its studio Cliffhanger Games

entries.check: VGC, 28 May 2025: "Electronic Arts has cancelled its Black Panther game and closed down the studio that was working on it."

entries.name: Cliffhanger Games
entries.summary: EA closed Cliffhanger Games, the studio making its Black Panther game.

sources.title: EA has cancelled its Black Panther game and closed its studio Cliffhanger Games

entries.check: VGC, 28 May 2025: EA "has shut down Cliffhanger Games", per IGN and an internal email from Laura Miele seen by VGC.

entries.name: BioWare
entries.summary: EA announced it was closing BioWare and its Edmonton workspace after deciding not to continue early development of a new Mass Effect.

sources.title: Building EA's Next Chapter

entries.check: EA, 21 Oct 2026: "We've made the decision not to move forward with this development, which means we're closing the studio and our Edmonton workspace."
entries.note: The date is EA's announcement. EA said it was closing the studio; the cited source doesn't give the day the closure took effect.

entries.name: Mass Effect (early development at BioWare)
entries.summary: EA stopped a small BioWare team's early development of a new Mass Effect game.

sources.title: Building EA's Next Chapter

entries.check: EA, 21 Oct 2026: a small team at BioWare was "working on early-development for Mass Effect"; EA decided "not to move forward with this development".

entries.name: Kult of Speed
entries.summary: Kult of Speed, an Electronic Arts Warhammer motorcycle racer for Amiga and PC due in June 1994, was reportedly cancelled and never released.

sources.title: Cult of Speed (Amiga, SEGA Mega Drive, PC)
New Details Emerge For Cancelled Warhammer Racing Game 'Kult Of Speed'

entries.check: Games That Weren't: started October 1993, "due for release in June 1994", "why was it canned"; Time Extension, 21 Apr 2025: "Planned for release by Electronic Arts", "it was never released".
entries.note: No source found dates the cancellation or gives a reason. Also known as Cult of Speed.
